definitions.translation: A rigid motion shifting every point by the same distance and direction.
definitions.reflection: A rigid motion mapping each point across a mirror line.
definitions.rotation: A rigid motion turning points around a fixed center by a given angle.
definitions.composition: Applying transformations successively, in a specific order.
definitions.symmetry: A correspondence mapping a figure onto itself by rotation or reflection.
definitions.tessellation: A pattern covering a plane without gaps or overlapping interiors.
